Players Committee card image of [[Margo]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Once during opponent's deploy phase, may use 1 Force to choose: 'break cover' of opponent's Undercover spy here or draw destiny; if destiny = number of opponent's characters at same site, to initiate battle here this turn requires +1 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Margo.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Margo.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
